paper_title: FreqKV Frequency Domain Key-Value Compression for Efficient Context   Window Extension
caption: : Perplexity evaluation on the validation set of PG-19 with different retaining ratios.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the perplexity (PPL) evaluation on the validation set of PG-19 under varying evaluation context lengths and different retaining ratios (γ). The x-axis represents the evaluation context length, ranging from 2K to 64K in logarithmic scale, with tick labels at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K. The y-axis shows perplexity, ranging from 7.7 to 8.2 in linear scale, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Three lines are plotted, each corresponding to a different retaining ratio: γ=0.25 (blue with circular markers), γ=0.5 (orange with circular markers), and γ=0.75 (green with circular markers). All three lines exhibit a sharp decline in perplexity from 2K to 4K context length, starting at approximately 8.2 for all ratios and dropping to around 7.8. From 4K to 64K, the lines show a gradual decrease or plateau, with γ=0.25 remaining slightly higher than the other two. At 64K context length, the perplexity values are approximately 7.78 for γ=0.25, 7.72 for γ=0.5, and 7.71 for γ=0.75, indicating that higher retaining ratios lead to slightly lower perplexity at longer context lengths.
